y-m-81-05.title: Zingaki izinhlamvu zesiHangul ezingenayo ibatchim?
y-m-81-05.goal: Hlukanisa isilinganiso sezimo ezingenzeka nesilinganiso esisetshenziswa ngempela ekubhaleni kwangempela, bese usho ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi nezindlela ezidingekayo ukuthola lesi sokugcina.
y-m-81-05.material: Ukhasi olulodwa lweHangul yesimanje lwenziwe ngenhlamvu yokuqala, ifonethikhi emaphakathi, futhi, uma ikhona, ibatchim. Isivumelwano salo msebenzi: bala izinketho ezingu-19 zenhlamvu yokuqala, ezingu-21 zefonethikhi, nezingu-28 zebatchim, kuhlanganise 'akukho batchim.' Isiqagelo: noma iyiphi inhlamvu yokuqala, ifonethikhi nebatchim kungahlanganiswa ngokukhululeka, futhi sibala izimo ezingenziwa. Asicabangi ukuthi lawo makhasi asetshenziswa ngempela yini.
y-m-81-05.thinking.1: Ukwehlukanisa amacala angenzeka nokuthi asetshenziswa kangakanani ngempela
y-m-81-05.prereq.2: Ukukwazi ukufunda amagama ezinhlamvu zesiHangul (incazelo yokuthi ukhasi lwenziwe ngenhlamvu yokuqala, ifonethikhi nebatchim isezintweni)
y-m-81-05.s.s1.prompt: Linganisela. Phakathi kwazo zonke izimo ezingenziwa, cishe yiyiphi ingxenye engamakhasi angenayo ibatchim?
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala inani lawo wonke amakhasi angenayo ibatchim nalawo anebatchim, ngalinye ngokuya ngezinombolo zezinhlamvu zokuqala, amafonethikhi namabatchim.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uthola isilinganiso sezibalo ezimbili, bheka ukuthi kwenzekani ezinombolweni zezinhlamvu zokuqala namafonethikhi.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.a: Uqhathanise inani lamacala angenabatchim nenani lawo wonke amacala. Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi izinombolo zezinhlamvu zokuqala namafonethikhi kungena ngokulinganayo ezinhlangothini zombili.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukungabi nabatchim kungu-1 kwamabatchim angu-28 angenzeka. Bala futhi ukuthi elilodwa kwangu-28 liyingxenye iyiphi yephelele.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukubona isabelo se-"akukho batchim" phakathi kwezinketho zebatchim ezingu-28 njengesishiyagalombili kukhulu kakhulu. Inhlamvu yokuqala nefonethikhi kuphindaphindwa ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke amacala.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.r.d: Kubukeka uhlukanise ngezimbili kuphela, "inebatchim" ne-"ayinayo", futhi wabona kuyingxenye nengxenye. Icala elinebatchim lihlukana libe yizinketho ezingu-27.
y-m-81-05.s.s1.explain: Amakhasi angenabatchim angu-19×21=399, futhi isamba singu-19×21×28=11172. Isilinganiso singu-399÷11172=1/28≈3.6%. Izinombolo zezinhlamvu zokuqala namafonethikhi ziphindaphindwa ngendlela efanayo noma likhona noma lingekho ibatchim, ngakho isilinganiso siba ngu-1 kwamabatchim angu-28.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.prompt: Ebona isilinganiso esitholwe ngenhla, umfundi wathi, "Khona-ke nasekubhaleni kwangempela, izinhlamvu ezingenayo ibatchim zizovela kuphela ngalesi silinganiso." Kuthiwani ngalesi sitatimende?
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi 'inani lezimo ezingenzeka' no-'inani lezikhathi ezivela ngazo ekubhaleni' kuyinto efanayo yini.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi uzothola siphi isiphetho uma ikhasi ngalinye livela inani elifanayo lezikhathi, nokuthi leso siqagelo singaba yiqiniso yini.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.a: Cha. Kodwa uma umbhalo uba mude kakhulu, usondela ngokuzenzakalelayo ku-3.6%.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.a: Inani elizinza njengoba umbhalo ukhula lisilinganiso esisetshenziswa ekubhaleni. Alihambi ngesilinganiso senani lezimo ezingenzeka.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.b: Akwazi ukusho. Ulwazi lokuthi kunezinhlobo ezingu-28 zamabatchim lungase luphutha.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.b: U-28 uyisivumelwano salo msebenzi. Inkinga akukhona inombolo evunyelwe kodwa ukuthi isilinganiso samanani singaguqulwa yini sibe ukuvama kokusetshenziswa.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.c: Cha. Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi inhlamvu ngayinye isetshenziswa kangakanani ekubhaleni.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.c: Wehlukanise inani lezimo ezingenzeka nenani langempela lokusetshenziswa. Ubone ukuvama kokusetshenziswa njengolwazi okufanele luphenywe ngokwehlukana.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.o.d: Yebo. Kuyisilinganiso phakathi kwazo zonke izinhlamvu ezingenzeka, ngakho kuyisilinganiso esifanayo nasekubhaleni.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.r.d: Isilinganiso se-"zimo ezingenzeka" nesilinganiso se-"zinhlamvu ezisetshenziswe ngempela" kuyahluka. Kuncike ekutheni inhlamvu ngayinye isetshenziswa kangakanani.
y-m-81-05.s.s2.explain: U-11172 yinani 'lezimo ezingasetshenziswa.' Ekubhaleni kwangempela, amakhasi athile asetshenziswa kakhulu futhi amanye cishe awasetshenziswa. Ngaphandle kwesiqagelo sokuthi zonke izimo zisetshenziswa ngokulinganayo, awukwazi ukuguqula isilinganiso samanani sibe yisilinganiso sokusetshenziswa.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.prompt: Wawuzoyithola kanjani isilinganiso samakhasi angenabatchim ekubhaleni kwangempela? Bhala indlela nomkhawulo owodwa okungenani wale ndlela.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha umbhalo owodwa ozowufunda bese ucabanga ngendlela yokuhlela amakhasi awo abe amaqembu amabili (akukho batchim / kunebatchim).
y-m-81-05.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umphumela ungethenjwa yini uma ukhetha umbhalo owodwa kuphela.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale kokubili ukuthi ukhetha kanjani umbhalo nenqubo yokwenza isilinganiso kusukela emiphumeleni ebaliwe?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma ubhala umkhawulo, ingabe ukhombisile ngokuqondile 'lokho le ndlela engeke ikutshele khona'?
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.0: Khetha umbhalo owodwa, bala amakhasi angenabatchim, bese uhlukanisa ngenani eliphelele lamakhasi ukuthola isilinganiso. Kodwa umbhalo owodwa ungaba nehlangothi ngenhlanhla, ngakho kufanele uqoqe imibhalo eminingana ubale ngendlela efanayo ukuze wethembe.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.1: Khetha ikhasi elilodwa lencwadi, bala amakhasi angenabatchim nawo wonke amakhasi, bese uthola isilinganiso. Ikhasi elilodwa lingahluka ngohlobo lombhalo, ngakho kufanele uqoqe uqhathanise izinhlobo eziningi zemibhalo, njengezinkondlo nemibhalo echazayo.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Nginikeze njengomkhawulo ukuthi umphumela uncike ohlotsheni lombhalo.
y-m-81-05.s.s3.model.2: Bala izinhlamvu ezingenayo ibatchim kumbhalo owodwa bese uthola isilinganiso. Umbhalo owodwa ungaba nohlangothi ezicini zalowo mbhalo.

Isisu esingu-1 ngu-do, esingu-2 ngu-gae, esingu-3 ngu-geol, esingu-4 ngu-yut, futhi u-0 (konke emhlane ababukhuphukile) ngu-mo. y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.info: Zonke izinduku ezi-4 ziyizinduku ze-yut ezinhle ezine-p=1/2. Phakathi kwamaphethini angu-16, i-yut iphethini e-1 (zonke izisu) futhi i-mo nayo iphethini e-1 (zonke izimhlane).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.ask: Yimuphi ovama kakhulu, i-yut noma i-mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.ask: Yimuphi ovama kakhulu, i-yut noma i-mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.after: Uma p=1/2, i-yut ne-mo zombili zingu-1/16, ngakho ziyalingana. Kodwa izinduku zangempela zingase zingabi ne-p elingana ngqo no-1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.a: I-yut ivama kakhulu. Kuyinto yemvelo kakhulu ukuthi isisu sibheke phezulu.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Uthe p=1/2, ngakho isisu nemhlane kunethuba elilinganayo. Lesi sizathu asifaneli isiqagelo esinikeziwe.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.b: I-mo ivama kakhulu. I-mo ikuhambisa kude, ngakho kungenzeka inzima kakhulu.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.b: Amaphuzu amakhulu nethuba elincane kuyizinto ezahlukile. Ngaphansi kwalesi siqagelo, kufanele uqhathanise ngenani lamaphethini.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.o.c: Yomibili imiphumela iphethini e-1 kwamaphethini angu-16, ngakho ivama ngokulinganayo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.0.r.c: Uqhathanise ngokubala inani lamaphethini. Lokhu kuqhathanisa kuncike esiqagelweni sokuthi p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.info: Ujikijele induku eyodwa yangempela ye-yut izikhathi ezingu-100, futhi isisu savela izikhathi ezingu-60 (cabanga ukuthi zonke izinduku ezine zinesimo esifanayo).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.ask: Ucabanga ini ngo-yut no-mo ngemva kokubona le datha?
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.after: Ithuba lokuthola izikhathi ezingu-60 noma ngaphezulu kwezingu-100 uma p=1/2 licishe libe ngu-3%. Alivamile, kodwa alinakwenzeka, ngakho noma ucabanga ukuthi p inkulu kuno-0.5 noma ugcina isinqumo sakho sokuqala, kunengqondo inqobo nje uma usho ubufakazi bakho. Uma p=0.6, i-yut icishe ibe ngu-0.130 futhi i-mo icishe ibe ngu-0.026, ngakho i-yut icishe ibe izikhathi ezingu-5 zamathuba.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Kwakungu-60, ngakho singamisa p=0.6, futhi singasho ukuthi i-yut ivama cishe izikhathi ezingu-5 kunomo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ukujikijela izikhathi ezingu-100 akuyona inombolo enkulu. U-0.6 uyisilinganiso, hhayi inani elinqunyiwe, futhi ungaba ngu-0.55 noma 0.65.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.b: p ingaba cishe ngu-0.6, ngakho i-yut ingavama kakhulu kune-mo. Kodwa qaphela ukuthi ivama kangakanani.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Usho nokungaqiniseki esilinganisweni. Isinqumo sakho sixhumanisa inani ledatha nokuzethemba kwakho.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.c: Isisu savela izikhathi ezingu-60 futhi imhlane izikhathi ezingu-40, ngakho isilinganiso se-yut ne-mo nasso singu-60:40, cishe izikhathi ezingu-1.5.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Ku-yut, zonke izinduku ezine kufanele zikhombise isisu, ngakho yi-p ephindaphindwe kane. Awukwazi ukusebenzisa isilinganiso senduku eyodwa njengoba sinjalo.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.o.d: Okungu-60 kwangu-100 kungenzeka ngenhlanhla, ngakho kusenesizathu esincane sokushiya isinqumo sokuqala sokuthi p=1/2.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Ucabange ibanga elingachazwa yinhlanhla futhi wagcina isinqumo sakho sokuqala. Ungacabanga nokuthi kuze kube kuphi kuleli banga kuba nzima ukubiza ngokuthi yinhlanhla.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.info: Izinduku ezine ziyahluka komunye nomunye: izinduku ezimbili zinethuba lesisu elingu-0.6, futhi ezinye ezimbili zinethuba lesisu elingu-0.4 (izinduku azithintani).
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.after: I-yut ingu-0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4=0.0576 futhi i-mo ingu-0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6=0.0576, ngakho ziyalingana. Uma i-p yazo zonke izinduku ifana, i-yut ne-mo ziyalingana kuphela uma p=1/2, kodwa uma induku ngayinye ihlukile, zingalingana ngenhlanhla njengalokhu.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.a: I-yut ivama kakhulu, ngoba ezinye izinduku zinethuba lesisu elingu-0.6.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Kunezinduku ezine-0.6, kodwa kunezinduku ezine-0.4 nazo. Bhala amathuba e-yut ne-mo ngalinye njengomphumela bese uqhathanisa.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.b: Akunakunqunywa ngombandela wokuthi izinduku azithintani kuphela.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.b: Ngombandela othi 'azithintani,' ungaphindaphinda amathuba. Hlola futhi ukuthi amanani owadingayo asevele enikeziwe yini.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.c: I-mo ivama kakhulu, ngoba ezinye izinduku zinethuba lesisu eliphansi.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Kwa-mo, kufanele ucabange nokuthi induku ene-0.6 iwela emhlane ngethuba elingu-0.4.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Ziyalingana. I-yut ingu-0.6×0.6×0.4×0.4 futhi i-mo ingu-0.4×0.4×0.6×0.6, ngakho imiphumela iyafana.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Uqhathanise i-yut ne-mo ngokubhala ngayinye njengomphumela. Uqaphele ukuthi izinombolo ezifanayo zisetshenziswa kuzo zombili, izinduku zikhombisa isisu ohlangothini olulodwa nemhlane kolunye.
y-m-81-03.s.s2.reflect: Isinqumo sakho uma p=1/2 sashintsha kanjani ngemva kwedatha yokujikijela izikhathi ezingu-100 nangemva kokufunda ukuthi p ihluka induku ngayinye? Sho ukuthi ulwazi olusha lushintshe isinqumo sakho noma lushintshe ukuthi uqiniseka kangakanani.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.prompt: Ukusho ukuthi 'i-yut ne-mo zivama ngokulinganayo,' yini enye ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi ungaqhathanisa kanjani uma usunalo? Kubhale.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala eceleni komunye nomunye ukuthi induku ngayinye kufanele iwele kanjani ku-yut nokuthi kufanele iwele kanjani ku-mo.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi udinga ukwazi yimaphi amanani ukuze uqhathanise ezimbili ngezinombolo.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ulwazi olubhalile lusetshenziswa ngempela ukubala ithuba le-yut nethuba le-mo?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucabange nokuthi izinduku ziyathintana yini (ukuzimela)?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe wehlukanise 'uma zonke i-p zifana' no-'uma induku ngayinye ihlukile'?
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.0: Udinga ukwazi ithuba p lokuthi induku ngayinye iwele isisu sibheke phezulu. Uma zonke izinduku ezine zinayo i-p efanayo, i-yut ne-mo ziyalingana kuphela uma p=1/2; uma induku ngayinye ihlukile, kufanele uqhathanise umphumela wamathuba esisu enduku ngayinye nomphumela wamathuba emhlane.
y-m-81-03.s.s3.model.1: Udinga ukwazi ithuba lenduku ngayinye lokuwela isisu sibheke phezulu nokuthi izinduku ziyathintana yini (ukuzimela). Ngalawo manani, phindaphinda wonke amathuba esisu e-yut nawo wonke amathuba emhlane e-mo, bese uqhathanisa.

y-m-81-06.prereq.0: U-'H3' kulo msebenzi ulebula nje yezinga lobunzima nosizo kule batch yokukhiqiza. Akusho ukuthi noma yisiphi isifundo sabelwe noma yiliphi ibanga. Isihloko se-'Math and Culture' sicatshangwa ukuthi sizoxazululwa abafundi abafunde kakade izibalo zesikole esiphakeme (izinombolo, izisho, imisebenzi namathuba alula).
y-m-81-06.title: Uma ikhona eyodwa isebenza, ingabe lonke iphethini liyasebenza?
y-m-81-06.goal: Thola izinhlanganisela eziningana lapho ama-engeli endaweni eyodwa engeza ku-360°, bese uhlulela ukuthi lo mbandela awukwanele ukugcwalisa yonke indiza.
y-m-81-06.material: Uma wenza iphethini, uxhuma amathayela amapholigoni ajwayelekile ngaphandle kwezikhala nangaphandle kokunqwabelana. Ama-engeli amathayela ahlangana endaweni eyodwa kufanele engeze ku-360°. Usayizi we-engeli eyodwa ye-n-gon ejwayelekile umiswa ngu-n (unxantathu ojwayelekile 60°, isikwele esijwayelekile 90°, i-hexagon ejwayelekile 120°). Kulo msebenzi sibheka kuphela icala lapho amapholigoni amathathu ajwayelekile ehlangana endaweni eyodwa, futhi inani lezinhlangothi liyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-50.
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Usayizi we-engeli engaphakathi yepholigoni ejwayelekile (i-geometry yesikole sesibili), ukuxazulula izingxenyana nezibalo
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Umqondo wamapholigoni ajwayelekile azungeza iphoyinti (ama-engeli engeza ekujikeni okuphelele)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Qagela kuqala. Ngaphandle kwama-hexagon amathathu ajwayelekile (6,6,6), yiziphi ezinye izinhlanganisela zamapholigoni amathathu ajwayelekile endaweni eyodwa lapho ama-engeli engeza ku-360°? (I-n-gon inezinhlangothi ezingu-n, futhi n ingu-50 ubukhulu.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Uma kunonxantathu o-1 ojwayelekile (60°), cabanga ukuthi isamba sama-engeli amapholigoni amabili asele kufanele sibe yini.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa indlela efanayo uma kunesikwele o-1 esijwayelekile (90°), bese uthola izinhlanganisela ezimbalwa.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Amapholigoni ajwayelekile ngaphandle konxantathu, isikwele ne-hexagon (njenge-octagon ejwayelekile) nawo anama-engeli. Kuthiwani uma uhlola eyodwa noma emibili yawo?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.o.b: Zimbalwa kuphela izinhlanganisela eziqukethe unxantathu ojwayelekile.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Hlola futhi ukuthi kukhona yini izinhlanganisela ezingenaye unxantathu ojwayelekile. Kuthiwani ngezamba eziqukethe i-pentagon ejwayelekile noma i-octagon ejwayelekile?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye kuvuliwe ukuthi amapholigoni angeyona onxantathu, izikwele nama-hexagon ajwayelekile angasetshenziswa. Ungahlola ngqo ukuqinisekisa inani.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: Kunzima ukuthola isizathu sokuthi kunenye eyodwa kuphela. Bala ngqo ukuthi zingaki izinhlanganisela ongazenza ngamapholigoni angeyona unxantathu, isikwele ne-hexagon ejwayelekile.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Uma uzifuna wena esinyathelweni esilandelayo, uzothola ukuthi kunezinhlanganisela ezingu-10 sonke, kuhlanganise ne-(6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake izinhlanganisela ezi-4 ezahlukile lapho i-a-gon ejwayelekile, i-b-gon ejwayelekile ne-c-gon ejwayelekile zihlangana endaweni eyodwa futhi ama-engeli engeza ku-360° ngqo. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, zonke izinombolo zemvelo. Bala inhlanganisela enokulandelana okuhlukile njengefanayo.)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza ithebula losayizi we-engeli eyodwa ye-n-gon ejwayelekile bese ubhala ambalwa kusukela ku-3.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha a encane kakhulu, thola ukuthi isamba sama-engeli amabili asele kufanele sibe yini, bese ushintsha b.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Amanani ezinhlangothi ayizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Amanani ezinhlangothi kufanele abe yizinombolo zemvelo kusukela ku-3 kuya ku-50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Sicela uzifake ngokulandelana a ≤ b ≤ c.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Bheka u-(5,5,10) phakathi kwezinhlanganisela owazithola. Endaweni eyodwa, ama-pentagon amabili ajwayelekile ne-decagon eyodwa ejwayelekile angagcwalisa u-360°. Khona-ke le nhlanganisela yodwa ingenza iphethini egcwalisa yonke indiza ngaphandle kwezikhala?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba amakhoneni ezimo eziseduze ezungeze uhlangothi olulodwa lwe-decagon ejwayelekile bese uhlola ukuthi inhlanganisela efanayo iyaqhubeka yini.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uma ama-pentagon amabili ajwayelekile ehlangana ohlangothini, hlola ukuthi ikhona eseduze nayo inika inhlanganisela efanayo yini.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Iphoyinti elilodwa elifanayo alanele ukwazi. Kufanele uhlole ngokwehlukana ukuthi amakhoneni aseduze nawo ayafana.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Wehlukanise ukuhambisana ephoyinteni elilodwa nokuhambisana yonke indawo. Uhlele ukuthi yini umbandela odingekayo nokuthi yini umbandela owanele.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: U-(4,6,12) kuphela, inhlanganisela esebenzisa zonke izinhlobo ezintathu, ongagcwalisa yonke indiza ngaphandle kwezikhala.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: U-(6,6,6) no-(4,8,8) nabo banamaphethini agcwalisa yonke indiza. Inani lezinhlobo akuyona indinganiso.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Ama-engeli endaweni eyodwa engeza kahle, ngakho ukuqhubeka ngendlela efanayo kuhlala kugcwalisa yonke indiza.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Ama-engeli endaweni eyodwa engeza kahle ngumbandela odingekayo. Ukuthi amakhoneni aseduze nawo asebenza nenhlanganisela efanayo kuyinto ehlukile.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Inani lezinhlanganisela ezisebenza endaweni eyodwa lihlala lilingana nenani lamaphethini agcwalisa indiza.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Umbuzo ukuthi yonke inhlanganisela igcwalisa yonke indiza yini. Alukho isizathu sokuthi inani lezinhlanganisela nenani lamaphethini kulingane.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Ama-engeli endaweni eyodwa engeza ku-360° ngumbandela odingekayo, hhayi owanele. Njengoba kwaziwa, phakathi kwezingu-10 ezingenhla, u-(3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), no-(6,6,6) kuphela agcwalisa yonke indiza ngohlobo olulodwa lokuhlelwa kwekhoneni, futhi u-(5,5,10) akakwazi ukugcwalisa yonke indiza ngoba ukuqhubeka kumakhoneni aseduze kuholela empikiswaneni.
